criteria: plumber.html is one self-contained, runnable C64-style platformer: canvas pixel-art, a menu to pick mode/difficulty/theme/start level, the three modes (1 Player, 1P+CPU, CPU+CPU), at least four named levels (Boot Valley, Crystal Cache, Frozen Stack, Lava Kernel), gravity/jump/tile collision, enemies (Crabs/Bit Beetles/Spark Slimes), gold-bolt collectibles, a glowing service gate, lives + timer + score HUD, an Escape pause, a visibly-working CPU that races to the gate, and a game-over screen. No empty functions or TODOs.
